name: Anagram
short_desc: Check if two strings are anagrams (same characters, same frequency).
description:
Given two strings s and t, return True if t is an anagram of s.

Two strings are anagrams if they contain the same characters with the
same frequency (case-sensitive).

Function signature:
  def Anagram(s1: str, s2: str) -> bool

Examples:
  Anagram("racecar", "carrace")             -> True
  Anagram("racecar", "carace")              -> False
  Anagram("listen", "silent")               -> True
  Anagram("Conversation", "Voices rant on") -> False
  Anagram("", "")                           -> True
